questions.question: Write a function square_sum(nums) that returns sum of squares.
questions.answer:
Write a function square_sum(nums) that returns sum of squares.
def square_sum(nums): return sum(x*x for x in nums) Reason: Generator expression avoids building a second list. O(n) time, O(1) extra space (excluding result object). Complexity: O(n) / O(1)
questions.explanation: Expected result: Returns the calculated numeric result.

questions.question: Return first unique character or None.
questions.answer:
Return first unique character or None.
def first_unique(s): c={} for ch in s: c[ch]=c.get(ch,0)+1 return next((ch for ch in s if c[ch]==1), None) Reason: Two passes keep logic simple and linear. Complexity: O(n) / O(k)
questions.explanation: Expected result: Compare with the code and verify one edge case.

questions.question: Flatten nested one-level list safely.

def flatten(rows): return [x for row in rows for x in row] Reason: Nested comprehension mirrors two loops. Complexity: O(n)
